options.note: 805/825 mm against 825/845 mm for the standard seat.

options.type: slide the fork legs up in the clamps
options.note: Check tyre-to-mudguard and tyre-to-radiator clearance at full compression.

rules: Rear-axle drop is not seat drop: the seat sits mid-wheelbase, so it drops less than the rear axle.
A rear lowering link changes the linkage leverage ratio and makes the rear suspension softer.
Lowering the front by the same amount as the rear keeps rake and trail (see lowering_geometry()) but costs the same amount of ground clearance.
The side stand may need shortening after lowering.
